summary: Tests-writing (red-phase) run for issue #39. Committed: (1) byte-identical copy of the upstream solver parity corpus (viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) at ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/Fixtures/parity/v1/corpus.json; (2) SolverParityCorpusTests — corpus-contract stamping, intentional-tie/no-selection presence, and exact per-scenario replay of scores and earliest-wins selection through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer; (3) GeneratedClientAdoptionTests — red-phase structural gate asserting Package.swift declares swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime and that an OpenAPI document describing /api/v1/printer_profiles and /api/v1/colors is committed under Sources/ColorComposerCore; (4) five PaletteAPIClientTests migration-contract tests pinning /api/v1 paths, printer_profile_id query, Accept/Authorization headers, 401/5xx/undecodable error mapping, and envelope decoding across the coming generated-client migration; (5) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md documenting corpus location, schema, consumption, refresh command, and the README section queued for the implementation run. Environment block: this container has NO Swift toolchain ('swift' not on PATH), so no Swift test executed here; bin/lint self-reports 'Swift toolchain not available; skipping build and tests' and exits 0. All new/modified Swift files were grammar-verified with tree-sitter-swift (parse-clean). Semantics were verified by an exact Python re-implementation of the Swift scorer's canonical-order weighted squared error with positive-weight-missing exclusion and unknown-key dropping: all 12 corpus scenarios reproduced 12/12 with 0 mismatches (scores exact, selections exact, tie sets exact), so SolverParityCorpusTests is expected green on a Swift host against the current scorer. GeneratedClientAdoptionTests is intentionally red until the implementation run lands swift-openapi-generator/runtime, the OpenAPI document, and the PaletteAPIClient migration; Package.swift at this head verifiably contains neither dependency and no openapi.{json,yaml,yml} exists under Sources/ColorComposerCore. Parity findings for the PR description: 12 scenarios (5 exact-tie cases incl. symmetric offsets, duplicate vectors, three-way lps tie, zero-weight-channel tie, mixed 8-color palette; 2 no-selection all-excluded cases; missing-candidate/missing-target exclusions confirmed 'never zero brightness'; unknown weight key 'ultraviolet' ignored; all values dyadic so client/server doubles are bit-identical and equality is exact). README.md and Package.swift are outside the test-writing allowlist and were deliberately not touched.
